lines: Having released Bhava melt bonds-mudrā indeed śaktis; of principal of them Khecarī she and, by threefold utterance verbal.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavānmuktvā drāvayanti pāśānmudrā hi śaktayaḥ mukhyāsāṃ khecarī sā ca tridhoccāreṇa vācikī
